3_the_harness_is_exception_safe.what_it_does_now: every mutation registers its undo BEFORE it is made and the undos run in reverse whatever happened; every started instance is owned and is stopped up to twice with what did not settle reported; the process table is ASKED rather than assumed; a timeout is recorded instead of raised past the cleanup; and a failure is written out as evidence with the step, the exception and the cleanup that followed.
3_the_harness_is_exception_safe.what_was_wrong: a timeout after both starts escaped with ZERO stops, and the selector and library it tampered with were restored on the normal path only.
